title: MoTrans-15: Monetary policy surprises, central bank communication and equity-index responses for the largest economies, 2010-2025 (v2.1.1)
description:
MoTrans-15 (v2.1.1) is a standardized, replication-certified dataset of monetary policy surprises, central bank communications, macroeconomic controls, and equity-index return responses across 15 major economies from 2010 through 2025 (16 calendar years).

Dataset Characteristics:

  • Evaluation Window: 2010-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (16 calendar years).
  • Temporal Splits: TRAIN (2010-2021, 572 decisions), VALIDATION (2022-2023, 76 decisions), TEST (2024-2025, 70 decisions).
  • Embargo Protocol: Strict 60-day embargo prevents multi-horizon event window overlap across split boundaries.
  • Locked Out-of-Sample Test Split: Contains exactly 0 interest rate hikes, reflecting the global post-inflation monetary easing cycle.
  • Cross-Validation: 4 expanding rolling-origin evaluation folds plus a unified final_fit estimation partition (folds.csv).

Restricted Access Notice: Access is restricted upon request for academic research and replication due to derived equity return series from commercial index feeds. Closing price levels (level_local) are omitted. Access can be requested by emailing jaypatregaurav81@gmail.com.
